crossRefs.note: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
“ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “ ‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am…
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

translations.web: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
translations.bsb: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
translations.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
translations.asv: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
